(ja)༄༅/ /khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa grub pa'i zil dngar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgwa lo lu

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa grub pa'i zil dngar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgwa lo lugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang*// dbyer med bla ma la btud nas// de yi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang*// las kyi rim pa cung zad dbye// 'di la gsum/ sgrub pa'i thabs/ rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga las kyi rim pa'o// dang po ni/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dang*/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub la dkris pa'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang*/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dar dpyangs dang bcas pa'i rin po che'i rtse bran can/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa me phung 'bar ba'i skur gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga 'khor bcas kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur/

de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi yig 'bru margad kyi phreng ba lta bus bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ lus thams cad khyab/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsal/ gnod byed kyi gdug rtsub thams cad zhi nas gus shing 'dud pa dang*/ rang nyid mthu stobs rab tu rgyas shing yon tan phrin las mtha' dag grub par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la dran pa mngon du bzhag ste/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces snying po gtso bor bzla zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces las sngags kyang ci rigs par bzla/ spro na rtsa sngags sam sngags ring du grags pa'ang cung zad bzla'o// thun 'jog pa na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ rang gi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par mos la bsngo smon shis brjod spyi ltar bya/ bsnyen pa byed na/ de lta bu'i rim pas thun bzhir bcad la snying po 'bum phrag bzhi/ las sngags 'bum phrag gcig spro zhing nus na sngags ring yang ji ltar rigs pa bzla'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ stegs bu'i dbus su maṇ+ḍa lar sku brnyan nam me tog gi tshom bu gcig dgod/ de'i g.yas su rnam bum dang*/ g.yon du las bum bcud ldan/ mdun du 'bul gtor/ mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ nye logs su sngon gtor sogs 'du bya/ gnyis pa ni/ sngon gtor a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ a kā ros brlab/ rang skad cig gis khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag rnams spyan drangs par bsams la/ oṃ da sha dik lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye his spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka mā la ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/

gong gi sngags mthar ar+ghaṃ sogs btags pas mchod pa dang*/ na mas+sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po sde brgyad sogs// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol/ gang dag gsang sngags kyi cho ga mthong ba dang thos par mi dbang ba rnams kyang gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la rang gnas su dengs shig gal te mi 'gro na rab tu 'bar ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rjes mgo bo 'gems par byed do// zhes dang*/ a mṛ ta'i mthar sum+bha sogs sbrel/ rol mo dang bcas gtor ma phyir dor/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i khro tshogs du mas bgegs rnams phyir bskrad/ khro bo rnams rang nyid la thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba kun nas brtan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ yig las// rin chen snod kyi nang du ni// hūm̐ las mchod yon zhabs bsil dang*// me tog bdug spos snang gsal dang*// dri mchog zhal zas rol mo sogs// mchod rdzas bsam gyi mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar sbyar bas brlab/ skyabs sems nas bzlas pa gsol gdab bar gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa zhes sogs nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur ces pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ zhes pa'i tshab tu/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes sbyar/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi yig 'bru margad kyi phreng ba lta bus bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas las thams cad grub par gyur pa'i mos pas bzlas pa ci rigs mthar gsol ba gdab/ spro na tshigs bcad ji ltar rigs pa dang spel ba'am/ gang ltar yang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan bdud rtsi'i thal mo legs sbyar bas// byang sems spyi bor gshegs pa'i mthu stobs kyis// bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod pa'i dgra thabs mkhan// bcom ldan khro bo chen por phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ rnam bum bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ kha yangs pa/ zhabs zhum pa/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud kyis gang ba'i dbus su skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sogs nas/ dbur brgyan pa gyur ces pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar gsal gdab/ mchod bstod bya/ bzlas pa ni/ bum lha'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung*/ zhal nas thon/ gzungs thag la 'khril te bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar thim pas thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad bsdus te bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar thim/ sngags phreng dang sku'i cha rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la bzlas pa ci rigs pa'i rjes/

bum lha bdud rtsir zhu ba bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam/ las bum bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las las bum gyi nang du pad nyi la hūm̐ las bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang sngon g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pa dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khro bo'i chas thams cad dang ldan pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar gyur par mos te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ cung zad bzla/ khro bo khyed kyis bgegs bzlog par mdzod cig ces gsol bas las kyi lha 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba yid du 'ong ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭa i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ mchod cing bstod/ khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil// mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ kun 'grub mdzod bar gyis gsol ba gdab pa rnams slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// slob ma la bya ba ni/ las bum gyi chu dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus byas gral la 'khod/ sngon gtor gtong*/ srung 'khor bsgom/ me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu snyam pa kun slong byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams kyang legs par gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa 'di nyid rgyud sde chen po bzhi ka nas las kyi lha khyad par can du gsungs shing*/

'di'i sngags zlo ba po'i lta stangs kyis gzir ba'am/ sngags chus 'thor ba tsam gyis kyang gdon dang*/ bgegs dang*/ log par 'dren pa rnams phyogs su nye mi nus pas mtshon byin rlabs dang dngos grub kyi gter chen por gyur pa la'ang sgrub thabs dang man ngag gi bka' srol ci rigs par mchis pa las/ 'dir paṇa grub dbang po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa nas nye bar brgyud cing*/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dpal chen po rgwa lo tsā bas snang bar mdzad pa'i rjes gnang zab mo gsan pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul 'tshal/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yi// rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol// rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum gyi chus bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sogs nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par bsgom mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi rten 'di nyid kyang bsgrubs zin pa ltar khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sogs nas/ hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa dang*/ slob dpon kyang khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dngos su gsal ba la mos 'dun drag pos byas pas slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi sku'i gnas thams cad nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs dang me'i tshwa tshwa lta bu 'phros pas lus la gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad/ khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i lha tshogs bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs khyed rang rnams la thim pas/

khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur cing ye shes pa phebs byung snyam pa gyis la sems ma bcos par rang babs su 'jog mdzod/ sngags mthar ā be sha ya aḥ.aḥbatags pa mang du brjod cing spos rol bya/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i rim pa song nas/ dngos gzhi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi slob dpon gyis// bdag la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yi// sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang stsol// de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon mdun bskyed khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa rnams kyis bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rnam bum spyi bor bzhag cing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ bum chu sbyin/ zhes pas dbang bskur bas sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ des khyed rang rnams kyis lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag lus la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad 'byung po mi dang ma yin gyi gnod pa grib dang mi gtsang ba dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad zhi/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi sgo nas khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sku bsgom pa la dbang*/

'bras bu mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sprul pa'i sku 'grub par 'gyur ba ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ mdun bskyed dang slob dpon gnyis ka bdud rtsi 'khyil par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa zhig chad/ khyed rang rnams bdud rtsi 'khyil par gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ gi mthar 'khod par bsgoms la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod ces brda sbyar la/ sngags lan gsum bzlar gzhug de nas khyed rang rnams kyis slob dpon la me tog gi phreng ba re phul bar bsams la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// gsum/ slar yang sngags phreng de nyid me tog gi phreng bar byas nas spyi bor bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog 'thor/ des khyed rang rnams kyis ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag ngag la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i 'gal rkyen zhi/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi sgo nas khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzla ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu tshangs dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub par 'gyur ba ni gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon bdud rtsi 'khyil par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog de'i thugs ka nas thugs phyag mtshan rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dang*/

rdo rje'i zhags pa'i tshogs du ma 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi'i 'khyil pa'i thugs kyi dngos grub thob snyam pa gyis la phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ sku'am tshom bu slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ sngags mthar badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod/ des khyed rang rnams kyis yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma rig pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag yid la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i rkyen nad gdon bgegs dang sdig sgrib bar chad 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa/ grib dang mi gtsang ba/ ma rig pa/ mi shes pa dang gti mug la sogs pa'i mi mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad zhi/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ yid kyi sgo nas khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu mkhyen brtse nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i chos kyi sku 'grub par 'gyur ba ni thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de lta bu'i rjes gnang thob nas dam tshig la gnas shing 'di nyid yi dam du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag gi slad du maṇ+ḍal dbul/ lus longs spyod drug cha 'bul snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ des khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rjes gnang thob pa yin pas/ de'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po sgrubs shig ces dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs bsngo smon byas nas slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtong ngo*// 'di ni rjes gnang gcig shes kun grol gyi phyag len 'bring po ltar bris pa yin la/ rgyas par spro na lha zhi drag gi khyad par cung zad ma gtogs/ 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi gsung rab sgrol dkar gyi cho ga zla ba'i 'dod 'jo'i rjes gnang la lha sngags kha bsgyur bas grub pa yin no// gsum pa ni/

mchod pa zhal gsos bsang sbyangs byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas gtang rag gi mchod bstod bya/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ rang gi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par mos la bsngo smon shis brjod bya/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// gsum pa las tshogs mdo tsam brjod na/ ril bu sngags mdud 'khor lo dang*// sbyin sreg khrus kyi cho ga ste// las kyi rim pa rnam lnga yis// rang gzhan phan bde bsgrub par bya// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po la gnyis/ sgrub pa dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ 'byung po gdug pa can rnams kyi yid dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ mthong ba dang*/ kha rlangs dang*/ reg pa'i dug lnga yod pa'i gnyen por/ mu zi nag po/ gla rtsi zol med/ shu dag nag po/ rma bya'i mdongs/ gu gul nag po'o// de lta bu'i rdzas la yi dwags phra mo'i tshogs kyis dri ro'i nus pa brku ba'i bgegs 'phrog pa'i rdzas ni/ shing kun/ rta bon pa/ rwa gzhob/ dri chen/ dri chu'o// rdzas de la gnyen po dang rig sngags gzhan gyi gnod pa zlog pa'i rdzas ni/ btsan dug rgya tshil/

khyi rgya bo'i brun gyi rtse mor dkar po 'byung ba de'o// sha chen/ tshil chen/ spyang brun lnga/ de ltar rdzas bco lnga po de rnams rdo gzhong du pad+ma 'dab bzhi dbus dang lngar/ dbus su mu zi nag po/ btsan dug dri chu gsum/ shar gyi 'dab mar gla rtsi/ dri chen/ rgya tshil/ lho'i 'dab mar gu gul/ rwa gzhob/ spyang brun/ nub kyi 'dab mar rma bya'i sgro/ rta bon pa/ tshil chen/ byang gi 'dab mar shu dag shing kun/ sha chen rnams bkod pa'i mthar mchod pas bskor/ byang chub sems gnyis sgo du ma nas yid la byas te mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed gong ltar gsal gdab/ bzlas pa'i skabs/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma kha sbyor gyi dbus su yi ge mam̐ gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ spyir sems can thams cad dang*/ khyad par sems can gdug pa can thams cad bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i go 'phang la bkod par gyur pa'i mos pas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces snying po ci nus su bzla/ bye brag tu sngags kyi yi ge de rnams mgar gyi sol me ltar 'bar ba las khro bo bcu mi mor gnas pa'i rig sngags 'bru drug par gyur par mdun gyi sman rnams kyi ngo bor bzhugs par bsgoms te/ oṃ dā na ri hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes las sngags kyang bzlas pas legs par bsngags/ thun bsdu ba na bdag bskyed dang rdzas lha sngags kyi ngo bor gyur pa la mchod bstod dang*/ bsngo smon shis brjod sogs byas te rdzas rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus la zhib tu 'thags/ ril bur dril/ 'di dag gi skabs su'ang rdzas rnams ngo bo lha la rnam pa ye shes kyi me 'bar bar bsgom/ de nas ril bu rin po che'i snod du blug mchod pa bsham/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas gong ltar dang*/ ril bu lha dang sngags kyi ngo bo ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pas dri ro sgra tshor ba'i gnas su'ang phyogs skyong bcu sogs 'byung po rnams kyis glags mi rnyed par ye shes kyi mes sreg pa'i nus pa can du gyur par mos te snying po dang*/

las sngags bzla/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ rang gi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros te bdag nyid dang ril bu lha'i ngo bor gnas pa la mchod par mos te mchod bstod dang*/ 'dod don gsol/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya/ de ltar zhag bdun phrag gcig gam/ gnyis sam/ gsum du khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas legs par bsgrubs zin pa na ril bu de dar sna lngas dril te/ rin chen bzang po lnga dang*/ nor bu 'od 'phro ba dang lhan cig tu sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams dang lhan du bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ 'di nyid sman gzhan dang ma 'dres par byas te 'bras sogs la srab mthug bya sgro tsam du byugs na reg pas grol ba dang*/ dri chus ril bu byas nas yungs kar tsam lto stong la btang na steng gdon dang 'og gdon dang 'go nad thams cad thub pa dang*/ sri'u gson mi lpags kyis gtums te ma bu gnyis ka'i mgul du bcangs na 'tshe ba thams cad las grol ba dang*/ lus kyi bu ga dgur dge slong rnam dag gi bdud rtsi dang sbyar te ma chag par byugs na byad gtad phar la byas pa tshur la mi ldog pa dang*/ gzhan gyi byad gtad phur kha rnams kyang bzlog par 'gyur zhing*/ rdzas 'di dag gi khar gza' dug ru sbal khog pa/ phag rgod mche ba rnams dang bsres te btang na steng 'og gi gdon thams cad thub cing*/ gyang rol rnying pa dang sha pho ru rta'i phye ma dang sbyar te chu grang gis phul te btang na thog dang brgyal thabs lta bus kha lkug pa'ang bye bar 'gyur ro// sman 'di dag dang*/ bzang drug gu gul dkar nag rgya spos/ tsan+dan dkar po/ a ga ru sogs dang sbyar te me la bsregs na 'byung po gdug pa can rnams rgyang grags gnyis tshun la nye bar 'ong mi nus so// de'ang ye shes ḍā kis slob dpon dgra las rnam rgyal la dri dang sgra'i sgo nas nad gdon srung ba'i gdams pa 'di gnang ba/ rdo rje gdan du yams nad byung ba la dung gi nang du byugs nas bus pas yams nad chad pa dang*/

shrī nā len+d+rar yams nad byung dus dge 'dun gyi dri gtsang khang gi sgor byugs pas yams nad chad skad pa 'di/ mkhas pa chen po ba ri lo tsās bsgyur te rgyal ba'i dbang po mi bskyod zhabs sogs kyis phyag len du gtan la phab pa'i yid ches can yin no// gnyis pa ni/ rtswa ku sha'am/ gzhon nus mas bkal ba'i skud pa la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab ste snying po dang las sngags kyis mngon par bsngags pa skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas su bcings pas bgegs kyi tshogs spyi dang*/ khyad par khams dang bla gnas 'pho ba'i nyes pa kun srung bar bshad do// gsum pa ni/ gro ga'am/ shog bu la 'khor lo mu khyud drug tu bskor ba'i lte bar rdo rje rgya gram gyi dbus dang phyogs kyi rwa ba bzhi la hūm̐ re res mtshan pa dang*/ mu khyud dang po la rdo rje'i zhags pa'i phreng bas bskor ba ni yid srung bar byed pa thugs kyi 'khor lo/ mu khyud gnyis par snying po dang las sngags kyi mthar bsgrub bya'i ming dang gang bsrung bar 'dod pa'i spel tshig gi mthar rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru zhes bris pa ni ngag srung bar byed pa gsung gi 'khor lo/ mu khyud gsum par sngags ring*/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ phyag 'tshal lo kun nas sku gsung thugs rdo rje la/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ phyag 'tshal lo rdo rje khro bo/ ma hā daṃ ṣ+ṭot+ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ chen po mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs su rung ba/ a si mu sa la/ ral gri gtun shing*/ pa ra shu pā sha hastā ya/ dgra s+t+wa zhags pa phyag na bsnams pa la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zo zo zo zhig zo zhig hu lu hu lu/ chug cig chug cig tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ gnas par gyis gnas par gyis/ ban+dha ban+dha/ chings chings/ ha na ha na/ rgyob rgyob/ da ha da ha/ sregs sregs/

pa tsa pa tsa/ chos chos/ gardzadza gardzadza/ sgrogs sgrogs/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ rnam par khos rnam par khos/ sarba bigh+nān bi nā ya kā na/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad/ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti dzī wi tān+ta ka rā ya swā hā/ tshogs bdag chen po'i srog mthar byed pa la/ zhes pa'i mthar spel tshig dang bcas pa ni srung bar byed pa sku'i 'khor lo/ mu khyud bzhi par dbyangs gsal dang rten snying spel tshig dang bcas pa ni bya ba srung byed yon tan gyi 'khor lo/ lnga par rdo rwa dang drug par me ris bskor ba ni byed pa srung ba phrin las kyi 'khor lo ste/ de ltar legs par bris nas gur gum/ gi wang*/ shu dag rnams kyis byug lhar bskyed bstim rab tu gnas pa dang bcas 'od du zhu ba las bris pa'i 'khor lo'i rnam par bsams te slar yang brtan bzhugs dang shis pa brjod cing me tog gi char dbab/ lte ba ma nyams par blta ba/ tshon skud kyis dkris te mgul lam dpung par btags na rdo rje'i srung ba chen por 'gyur ro// bzhi pa ni/ rgyas par gsang ba spyi'i cho ga las byung bas khog phub ste 'di nyid kyi lha sngags 'byin 'jug bya/ bsdus pa glo bur ba'am/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor lta bu'i tshe/ kham phor du shug pa sogs rung ba'i bud shing brtsegs pa'i mdun du mchod gtor bsham/ rang gi mdun du til cung zad 'du bya/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ las mthun gyi me sbar la bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa zhes sogs mdun bskyed ltar bskyed/ mchod cing bstod/ de nas rang ngam bsgrub bya'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung grib dang mi gtsang ba nad gdon 'byung po'i 'tshe ba thams cad 'od nag po'i rnam par snying gar 'dus pa rlung dang 'grogs te sna bug nas byung*/

mdun gyi til la thim pa khro bo'i rgyal po'i zhal du phul bas thugs ka'i ye shes kyi mes lhag med du bsregs par bsams la/ sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ kle sha da ha na bhasmi ku ru swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs dbul/ mthar gtor 'bul/ 'dod gsol/ nongs bshags/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o// 'dis spyir mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing*/ khyad par bsnyen sgrub sogs kyi skabs grib dang mi gtsang ba'i ltas byung na nges par phan no// lnga pa ni/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas bum pa gong bzhin bsgrub/ sbyang ba gsum dang bkru byabs srung ba sogs rnam 'joms lta bu'i khrus chog la lha sngags bsgyur te bgyis pas grib dang nad gdon sogs la shin tu phan/ tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i bum chu gnas dang yo byad sogs la 'thor bas de dang de'i grib zhi ba dang*/ bsnyen sgrub kyi skabs bkru ba dang*/ khong du btung bas dbang po gsal zhing khams dwangs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bar chad thams cad sel ba sogs la mchog tu bsngags shing myang bas kyang grub/ bum sgrub rgyas par ma grub kyang*/ rin po che'i snod du chu gtsang ma blugs pa mdun du bdar te bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu'i steng du nyi ma la hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces bsams la/ snying po dang las sngags bzla/ mthar sngags phreng gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba las chu nus pa dang ldan par mos te/ gong bzhin las la sbyar bas kyang phan bde 'phral du ster bar 'gyur ro// grub pa'i zhal lung dag byed gter// bsrubs skyes gdams pa'i zil dngar gyis// sa gsum 'gro ba'i gdung sel zhing*// thar bde'i ngal 'tsho rgyas gyur cig

/ces pa'ang 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i zhal snga nas 'di'i rjes su gnang ba nos shing*/ man ngag gi yig cha cung zad mthong ba la brten nas bya bral 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gzhan la phan pa'i sems kyis sbyar ba rnam pa kun tu dge legs su gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
